name: Natalia Greenwood
source:
MBTI: INTJ

"Oh, we'll be getting along. Regardless of whether it's in a well-meaning manner or if I simply need to make any of you."

The stern academic genius who prefers to keep both her enemies and her allies at a distance. Clever and cold, Natalia knows exactly what needs to be done and isn't afraid to raise her voice. Claiming her last recallable memory was returning to her room after the conclusion of her school term, Natalia quickly makes it apparent she expects everyone's cooperation and won't be taking 'no' for an answer.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
